description: Canary ConfigMap split and pre-launch fixes for pmc-epmmformquerygui. IMPORTANT - THIS IS NOT A CODE PROJECT: the repo root is dev/k8s and it contains only Kubernetes/Istio YAML manifests, shell scripts and Traditional-Chinese markdown. There is no compiler, no test suite, no package to build. The typecheck equivalent is `bash scripts/validate.sh` run from the repo root; exit code 0 means the check passed. That script does not exist yet - US-001 creates it, and EVERY LATER STORY MUST ADD ITS OWN ASSERTIONS TO scripts/validate.sh IN THE SAME COMMIT as the change it is verifying. That is the single most important rule in this PRD: it is what keeps the script green at every commit and what stops a later story from silently breaking an earlier one. TOOLING: this machine has node/npm/npx only. There is NO kubectl, NO yq, NO usable python (only the Microsoft Store stub). Do not try to install kubectl, do not try to reach a cluster, do not run `kubectl apply` even with --dry-run - it will not exist. YAML parsing is done with the js-yaml CLI pinned as a devDependency (US-001 sets this up). SCOPE: dev/k8s only. The Spring Boot backend lives in a separate repo at dev/spring_oauth2_backend and is deliberately OUT OF SCOPE - in particular the SecurityConfig permitAll change that US-007 depends on, and the whole BFF-proxy phase, are not part of this run. Never edit files outside dev/k8s. SOURCE OF TRUTH: canary-manual/CANARY-COMPLETE.md holds the full target state - section 3.1 (how config is loaded) and Appendix C (the required-key list) are the two most important sections, and section 3.5 contains the complete target ConfigMap. The original requirements are in tasks/prd-canary-configmap-split-and-hardening.md. Read the relevant section BEFORE editing any manifest. WHAT IS BEING FIXED: the image's Dockerfile sets SPRING_CONFIG_LOCATION=file:/config/application.yaml (replace semantics, a path nothing mounts) while the Deployment sets SPRING_CONFIG_ADDITIONAL_LOCATION=file:/app/config/application.yml - the pod cannot start, and under replace semantics every key the ConfigMap omits silently falls back to a Java @Value default. Stories 002-006 make the ConfigMap complete and then flip the env var; stories 008-009 split the single shared ConfigMap into per-track -stable/-canary copies with a content-hash annotation. STYLE: YAML comments in this repo explain WHY at length - see track-a/release/20-deployment-stable.yaml for the density to match. Prose is Traditional Chinese. Five documents under canary-manual/ carry a 'superseded' banner; do not follow their operational steps, they contain known-wrong instructions. NOTE: canary-manual/ is a documentation tree, so nothing here is auto-deployed - but do not leave the repo in a state you would be embarrassed to have applied.

userStories.title: Add the ConfigMap keys that silently fall back to Java defaults
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I need the keys whose Java defaults are wrong for this environment written out explicitly, so that replace-semantics config loading does not silently change behaviour.
acceptanceCriteria: In canary-manual/track-a/release/10-configmap-1.2.3.yaml add `server.servlet.session.timeout: 8h` - the Spring default is 30 minutes

Add server.servlet.session.cookie with name `__Host-JSESSIONID`, same-site `lax`, secure `true`, http-only `true` - without the name key it falls back to JSESSIONID, which collides with the Envoy affinity cookie

Add `app.security.csp-policy` with the exact policy string from canary-manual/CANARY-COMPLETE.md section 3.5, and `app.security.csp-report-only: true` - the Java default for csp-policy is an empty string, which suppresses the CSP header entirely
Add `app.security.required-role: ""`
Add `spring.task.scheduling.pool.size: 2` - the default of 1 queues the canary roster reload behind the 60-second Keycloak token refresh
Add `app.canary.leave-path: /gui_epmmFormQuery/canary/leave` - this one value is read in three places in the backend and must not be left implicit

Add app.token-refresh.{enabled,skew-seconds,schedule-rate-ms}, app.silent-auth.{enabled,hint-cookie-name,hint-cookie-max-age-seconds,cookie-secure}, app.downstream.base-url and app.third-party.base-url, using the values in CANARY-COMPLETE.md section 3.5
Each key carries a comment; the ones listed in CANARY-COMPLETE.md Appendix C.2 must say what wrong value they would fall back to

Extend the scripts/validate.sh check from US-002 into a required-key list covering Appendix C.1, C.2 and C.3, asserting each key exists in the parsed application.yml and that session.cookie.name equals `__Host-JSESSIONID` and task pool size equals 2
The new checks are added to scripts/validate.sh in this same commit
`bash scripts/validate.sh` run from the repo root exits 0
userStories.notes: Cluster verification deferred: after deploy, the session cookie in the browser must be named __Host-JSESSIONID and a Content-Security-Policy-Report-Only header must be present.
